module_summary: Traffic-light controller: a one-hot phase FSM advances stop/go/warn when a child phase down-timer reaches 3; phase bits pass through two register stages to the lamp outputs, which the timer watches to reload.

anchors.name: lamp_sel
anchors.why: One-hot phase register (off/stop/go/warn) advanced on timer expiry.

anchors.name: remain
anchors.why: Remaining phase time from the child down-counter; decoded into expiry and exported.

anchors.name: expired
anchors.why: Phase-timeout flag gating every FSM phase transition.

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Registered lamp output (representative of red/yellow/green), fed back to the timer.

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Pedestrian request input shortening the green phase in the timer.

anchors.name: ahead_g
anchors.why: Stage register of phase bits before lamp outputs; timer uses it for edge detect.

anchors.name: clock
anchors.why: Countdown display output, copy of remain.

groups.name: phase_fsm
groups.description: One-hot phase register and next-state logic driven by timer expiry.

groups.name: phase_timer
groups.description: tl_timer child down-counter reloaded per phase, shortened by pedestrian request.

groups.name: lamp_outputs
groups.description: Two register stages carrying phase bits to the red/yellow/green outputs.
